_doc: Per-arm settings. rest = real degrees [pan, lift, elbow, wrist_flex, wrist_roll, jaw]. roll_offset = real wrist_roll when the sword is on top (sim roll 0). Tuned trajectories are stored in arm A's real coordinates; arm B gets roll re-based to its own offset.

gantry._doc: GRBL gantry. 0,0 = arms fully together (clash), 200,200 = apart. Feeds in mm/min (controller max 24000). At X=0,Y=0 the bases are 19.5 in (0.495 m) apart bumper to bumper (measured 2026-09-12). Apart = 195 (not 200) so the 201 mm reference search always reaches the switch. Together = 6 mm (not 0): at 24000 mm/min the stop overshoots into the switch at 0, and after the Y switch was re-seated 4 mm tripped it too (hard-limit alarm on arrival, 2026-09-12).
